You are an AI assistant tasked with solving command-line tasks in a Linux environment. You will be given a task description and the output from previously executed commands. Your goal is to solve the task by providing batches of shell commands.

Format your response as JSON with the following structure:

{
  "analysis": "Analyze the current state based on the terminal output provided. What do you see? What has been accomplished? What still needs to be done?",
  "plan": "Describe your plan for the next steps. What commands will you run and why? Be specific about what you expect each command to accomplish.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "ls -la\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "cd project\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    }
  ],
  "task_complete": true
}

Required fields:
- "analysis": Your analysis of the current situation
- "plan": Your plan for the next steps
- "commands": Array of command objects to execute

Optional fields:
- "task_complete": Boolean indicating if the task is complete (defaults to false if not present)

Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)
- "duration": Number of seconds to wait for the command to complete before the next command will be executed (defaults to 1.0 if not present)

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used completely verbatim as keystrokes. Write commands exactly as you want them sent to the terminal:
- You must end every command with a newline (\n) or it will not execute.
- For special key sequences, use tmux-style escape sequences:
  - C-c for Ctrl+C
  - C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies the number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (default: 1.0) before the next command will be executed. On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are sent exactly as written to the terminal
- Do not include extra whitespace before or after the keystrokes unless it's part of the intended command
- Extra text before or after the JSON will generate warnings but be tolerated
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes and special characters within strings
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action

Task Description:
You are the clinical bioinformatician of a rare-disease genetics laboratory. An external sequencing
provider delivered a joint variant call set for a family trio (an affected child and both parents).
The laboratory needs to know how the family differs from the laboratory's own reference assembly,
and the candidate causal variants for the gene panel of the referral.

Task directory:
- `/task`

Inputs (read-only) under `/task/input`:
- `trio.vcf.gz` (+ `.tbi`) - the provider's joint call set of the three family members, chromosome 22
  only, FORMAT fields `GT:AD:DP:GQ`. The provider states that the file is complete with respect to
  the reference sequence the provider worked with: at every position of that reference which is not
  covered by a record of the file, all three family members are homozygous for the base of the
  provider's reference.
- `pedigree.ped` - six-column PED file (family, individual, father, mother, sex, phenotype; phenotype
  2 = affected)
- `panel_genes.txt` - gene symbols of the referral's panel, one per line
- `lab_sop.md` - the laboratory's SOP for trio candidate review
- `resources/GRCh37.chr22.fa.gz`, `resources/GRCh38.chr22.fa.gz` (+ `.fai`, `.gzi`) - chromosome 22 of
  both human assemblies, bgzip-compressed, exactly as they are in use at the provider and at the
  laboratory (sequence outside the regions the laboratory works on is masked with N; coordinates are
  those of the full chromosome)
- `resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain`, `resources/hg38ToHg19.chr22.over.chain` - UCSC liftOver
  chain files restricted to chromosome 22
- `resources/GRCh38.chr22.canonical.gff3` - the laboratory's transcript set on GRCh38 (Ensembl GFF3
  conventions, one transcript per gene)
- `resources/popfreq.GRCh38.tsv.gz` - population allele frequencies, columns `chrom`, `pos`, `ref`,
  `alt`, `af` (GRCh38, 1-based, one ALT allele per row, left-aligned minimal representation)

Available software (on `PATH`): `bcftools` (with its plugins, including `+liftover`), `samtools`,
`bgzip`, `tabix`, `picard`, Python 3.12 with pysam, numpy, scipy and pandas. There is no internet
access.

Your task:
1. Deliver the call set of the family on GRCh38 in the laboratory's canonical representation.
2. Report which input alleles lie in sequence that cannot be placed on GRCh38.
3. Apply the laboratory SOP and report the candidate causal variants of the affected child.

Required outputs under `/task/output`:
- `trio.GRCh38.vcf.gz` plus its index (`.tbi` or `.csi`) - bgzip-compressed VCF on GRCh38 with the
  contig named `chr22`, sorted by position. It describes how the three family members differ from
  the GRCh38 reference sequence: it holds every allele that differs from the GRCh38 reference and is
  carried by at least one family member, for all GRCh38 positions that the provided chain file
  aligns to the provider's reference (the aligned blocks of the chain; sequence that the chain does
  not align and N-masked sequence are out of scope), and nothing else. One ALT allele per record;
  every record in left-aligned, minimal (parsimonious) representation with `REF` equal to the GRCh38
  reference sequence; differences of single bases are written as single-base records. The same
  three samples under their original names. `GT` of a sample states how many of its two chromosome
  copies carry the ALT allele of that record (`0/0`, `0/1` or `1/1`); a copy that carries any other
  allele counts as `0` in that record.
- `unmapped.tsv` - tab-separated with header `chrom_in`, `pos_in`, `ref`, `alt`: one row per ALT
  allele of the input that lies at a position of the provider's reference which the provided chain
  file does not align to GRCh38 chromosome 22, with chromosome, position and alleles as written in
  the input file. An input allele at an aligned position is never listed here, whatever it turns
  out to be on GRCh38. Header only if there is none.
- `candidates.tsv` - tab-separated with header `chrom`, `pos`, `ref`, `alt`, `gene`, `consequence`,
  `model`: one row per candidate variant under the SOP. `chrom`, `pos`, `ref`, `alt` exactly as in
  your `trio.GRCh38.vcf.gz`; `gene` is the gene symbol as written in `panel_genes.txt`;
  `consequence` is the qualifying class that the SOP assigns to the variant; `model` is one of
  `de_novo`, `compound_het`, `homozygous_recessive`. Header only if there is no candidate.

Constraints:
- Do not modify anything under `/task/input`; write deliverables only under `/task/output`.
- Do not ask for confirmation. Execute directly.

--- lab_sop.md ---
# SOP-GEN-017 (rev. 5) - Review of trio call sets for candidate causal variants

Scope: germline joint call sets of an affected child ("proband") and both parents, restricted to the
gene panel of the referral. All interpretation resources of the laboratory (transcript set,
population frequencies) are kept on GRCh38 with UCSC-style contig names, and results are issued on
GRCh38. Every rule below refers to the call set as expressed against GRCh38: "ALT allele" is an
allele that differs from the GRCh38 reference, and "carries n copies" counts the chromosome copies
of a family member with that allele.

1. **Representation.** Variants are compared with laboratory resources and reported as one ALT
   allele per row, left-aligned and minimal.
2. **Usable genotypes.** A genotype is usable if `DP` >= 10 and `GQ` >= 20. A variant is reviewed
   only if the genotypes of all three family members are usable. Genotypes that follow from a
   provider's statement of completeness (positions without a record in the delivered file) are
   usable.
3. **Allele balance.** If the proband carries one copy of the ALT allele, the variant is accepted
   only if the fraction of reads supporting the ALT allele, `AD_alt / (AD_ref + AD_alt)` with the
   read counts of the ALT allele and of the GRCh38 reference allele, lies between 0.25 and 0.75
   (limits included).
4. **Population frequency.** A variant is rare if its allele frequency in the laboratory frequency
   table is below 0.001. A variant that is absent from the table is treated as having frequency 0.
5. **Consequence.** Consequences are taken relative to the laboratory transcript set and describe
   what the chromosome copy of the proband that carries the variant encodes.
   - A variant is assessed on its own, with one exception: if one chromosome copy of the proband
     carries two or more single-nucleotide variants in the same codon, these are assessed together.
     Each of them then has the consequence of the codon with all of these changes applied, compared
     with the reference codon (`synonymous` if the amino acid is unchanged, `missense` if it is
     changed, `stop_gained` if a stop codon results). Single-nucleotide variants in one codon that
     lie on different copies are assessed separately, and so are all other combinations of variants.
   - Which copy carries a variant follows from the trio genotypes. A variant of which the proband
     carries two copies is on both copies. A variant of which the proband carries one copy is on
     the copy inherited from the mother if the mother carries the allele and the father does not,
     and on the copy inherited from the father if the father carries it and the mother does not. In
     all other cases (neither parent or both parents carry the allele) the copy cannot be assigned;
     such a variant is assessed together only with variants of which the proband carries two copies.
   - All variants of the call set that the proband carries count for this, whatever their
     frequency, genotype quality or own consequence.
   - A variant of which the proband carries two copies qualifies only if its consequence qualifies
     on both copies (if the two classes differ, report both joined by `&`).

   Qualifying classes: `missense`, `stop_gained`, `frameshift`, `splice_acceptor`, `splice_donor`.
   Every other consequence (synonymous, in-frame insertion/deletion, UTR, intronic, intergenic, ...)
   does not qualify.
6. **Panel.** Only variants with a qualifying consequence in a gene of the referral's panel are
   reviewed.
7. **Inheritance models.** A rare variant that passes rules 2-6 is reported if it fits one of:
   - `de_novo` - the proband carries one copy of the ALT allele, neither parent carries it;
   - `homozygous_recessive` - the proband carries two copies, each parent carries exactly one;
   - `compound_het` - the proband carries one copy each of two different variants in the same gene,
     one of them inherited from the mother only (the mother carries one copy, the father none) and
     the other from the father only (the father carries one copy, the mother none). Both variants
     are reported.
   Variants that fit none of these models are not reported.

Analysis: The SOP and trio structure are now clear: the proband is `F4955-29`, the father `F4955-78`, and the mother `F4955-67`. The input has 2,793 records on contig `22`, including multiallelic and indel examples. We still need characterize the provider-reference/GRCh37 relationship, chain blocks, REF consistency, input allele types, transcript/GFF conventions, and frequency table before building a robust normalization/liftover pipeline.
Plan: Inspect chain headers and block structure; inspect FASTA indices and actual contig names; check input REF alleles against GRCh37; summarize allele/genotype patterns; inspect GFF records and frequency-file formatting. These checks will determine whether a custom chain-aware converter is needed and how candidate annotation should be implemented.

import numpy as np, pysam, bisect
S=np.frombuffer(pysam.FastaFile('/task/input/resources/GRCh37.chr22.fa.gz').fetch('chr22').upper().encode(),dtype='S1')
T=pysam.FastaFile('/task/input/resources/GRCh38.chr22.fa.gz').fetch('chr22').upper()
chains=[]
for line in open('/task/input/resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain'):
    p=line.split()
    if p and p[0]=='chain':
        chains.append({'id':int(p[12]),'src0':int(p[5]),'dst0':int(p[10]),'strand':p[9],'blocks':[]})
    elif p:
        sz=int(p[0]); dt=int(p[1]) if len(p)>1 else 0; dq=int(p[2]) if len(p)>2 else 0
        b=chains[-1]['blocks']
        if b: src=b[-1][0]+b[-1][2]+dt; dst=b[-1][1]+b[-1][2]+dq
        else: src=chains[-1]['src0']; dst=chains[-1]['dst0']
        b.append((src,dst,sz))
comp=str.maketrans('ACGTN','TGCAN')
rows=[]; total=0
for c in chains:
    cm=0
    for src,dst,n in c['blocks']:
        s=S[src:src+n]
        t=np.frombuffer(T[dst:dst+n].translate(comp).encode(),dtype='S1') if c['strand']=='-' else np.frombuffer(T[dst:dst+n].encode(),dtype='S1')
        valid=np.char.upper(s.astype(str)) != b'N'
        if c['strand']=='-':
            tv=np.char.upper(t.astype(str)) != b'N'
            # reversed target array is already in source order; valid must align accordingly
            tv=tv[::-1]
            valid &= tv
        else: valid &= np.char.upper(t.astype(str)) != b'N'
        idx=np.where(valid)[0]
        dif=idx[s[idx]!=t[idx]]
        cm += len(dif)
        for j in dif:
            rows.append((c['id'],src+j+1,dst+j+1,s[j].decode(),t[j].decode(),c['strand']))
    total += cm
    print('chain',c['id'],'mismatches',cm)
print('total mismatches',total,'rows',len(rows))
# Group by chain and contiguous source/target positions.
runs=[]
for r in rows:
    cid,sp,tp,sr,tr,st=r
    if runs and cid==runs[-1][0] and sp==runs[-1][2]+1 and tp==runs[-1][4]+1 and st==runs[-1][6]:
        runs[-1][2]=sp;runs[-1][4]=tp;runs[-1][5]+=1;runs[-1][8]=tr
    else:
        runs.append([cid,sp,sp,tp,tp,1,st,sr,tr])
print('runs',len(runs))
for x in runs:
    print('RUN chain=%d src=%d-%d tgt=%d-%d n=%d strand=%s first=%s>%s last=%s>%s'%tuple(x))
# Summarize mismatch target positions by target nonN interval.
ivs=[(18900000,19500000),(21400000,22000000),(23600000,24200000),(41550000,42150000),(50050000,50650000)]
for a,b in ivs:
    n=sum(a<=x[2]<=b for x in rows)
    print('target interval',a+1,b,'mismatches',n,'minpos',min((x[2] for x in rows if a<=x[2]<=b),default=None),'maxpos',max((x[2] for x in rows if a<=x[2]<=b),default=None))

for line in open('/task/input/resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain'):

        chains.append({'id':int(p[12]),'src0':int(p[5]),'q0':int(p[10]),'qsize':int(p[8]),'strand':p[9],'blocks':[]})
    elif p:
        sz=int(p[0]);dt=int(p[1]) if len(p)>1 else 0;dq=int(p[2]) if len(p)>2 else 0
        b=chains[-1]['blocks']
        if b: src=b[-1][0]+b[-1][2]+dt; q=b[-1][1]+b[-1][2]+dq
        else: src=chains[-1]['src0']; q=chains[-1]['q0']
        b.append((src,q,sz))
block_starts=[];blocks=[]
for c in chains:
    for src,q,n in c['blocks']:
        if c['strand']=='+':
            dst=q
            ts=T[dst:dst+n]
        else:
            # genomic forward target for reverse-complement block
            dst=c['qsize']-q-n
            ts=T[dst:dst+n][::-1].translate(comp)
        ss=S[src:src+n]
        valid=(np.char.upper(np.frombuffer(ss,dtype='S1').astype(str))!=b'N') & (np.char.upper(np.frombuffer(ts,dtype='S1').astype(str))!=b'N')
        idx=np.where(valid & (ss!=ts))[0]
        if len(idx):
            block_starts.append(src)
            blocks.append({'id':c['id'],'src':src,'dst':dst,'n':n,'strand':c['strand'],'idx':idx})
order=np.argsort(block_starts); block_starts=[block_starts[i] for i in order]; blocks=[blocks[i] for i in order]
print('diff blocks',len(blocks),'mismatch bases',sum(len(b['idx']) for b in blocks))
covered=[]
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
    covered.append((r.pos-1,r.pos-1+len(r.ref),r.pos,r.ref,','.join(r.alts)))
covered.sort()
rows=[]
for rec in covered:
    a,b0=rec[0],rec[1]
    i=bisect.bisect_right(block_starts,a)-1
    hits=[]
    while i>=0 and i<len(block_starts):
        st=block_starts[i]; bl=blocks[i]
        if st>=b0: break
        lo=max(a,st); hi=min(b0,st+bl['n'])
        if lo<hi:
            js=bl['idx'][(bl['idx']>=lo-st)&(bl['idx']<hi-st)]
            for j in js: hits.append((bl['id'],st,bl['dst'],j,st+j,bl['strand']))
        i+=1
    if hits:
        rows.append((rec,hits))
print('records overlapping diffs',len(rows),'diff bases in records',sum(len(x[1]) for x in rows))
with open('/tmp/assembly_overlap_records.tsv','w') as o:
    o.write('src_pos\tsrc_ref\tsrc_alts\tchain\tblock_src0\tblock_dst0\tstrand\tj\tmismatch_src1\tmismatch_tgt1\tsrc_base\ttgt_base\n')
    for rec,hits in rows:
        _,_,pos,ref,alts=rec
        for cid,st,dst,j,srcpos,strand in hits:
            bl=blocks[bisect.bisect_right(block_starts,st)-1]
            if bl['strand']=='+': tgt=dst+j
            else: tgt=dst+bl['n']-j-1
            srcbase=chr(S[srcpos])
            tgtbase=chr(T[tgt]) if strand=='+' else chr(comp[T[tgt]])
            o.write(f'{pos}\t{ref}\t{alts}\t{cid}\t{st}\t{dst}\t{strand}\t{j}\t{srcpos+1}\t{tgt+1}\t{srcbase}\t{tgtbase}\n')
for rec,hits in rows[:40]:
    print('REC',rec[2],rec[3],rec[4],'n',len(hits),'first',hits[0])
PY

Analysis: The definitive run exposed a comparison bug: whole byte slices were compared, causing false mismatch records with identical displayed bases. The corrected coordinate mapper itself is valid, however, and maps the first locus exactly as the plugin does. We now need obtain the true mismatch list and its overlap with explicit records.
Plan: Create a concise vectorized chain analysis with element-wise base comparison, enumerate true provider/GRCh38 reference differences, report which overlap input REF spans, and inspect lifted plugin records at those loci.

import numpy as np, pysam, bisect
faS = pysam.FastaFile('/task/input/resources/GRCh37.chr22.fa.gz')
faT = pysam.FastaFile('/task/input/resources/GRCh38.chr22.fa.gz')
S = faS.fetch('chr22').upper().encode()
T = faT.fetch('chr22').upper().encode()
comp = bytes.maketrans(b'ACGTN', b'TGCAN')
chains = []
cur = None
for line in open('/task/input/resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain'):
    p = line.split()
    if not p:
        continue
    if p[0] == 'chain':
        chains.append({'id': int(p[12]), 'tStart': int(p[5]),
                       'qStart': int(p[10]), 'qSize': int(p[8]),
                       'strand': p[9], 'blocks': []})
        cur = None
    else:
        n = int(p[0])
        dt = int(p[1]) if len(p) > 1 else 0
        dq = int(p[2]) if len(p) > 2 else 0
        c = chains[-1]
        t, q = cur if cur is not None else (c['tStart'], c['qStart'])
        c['blocks'].append((t, q, n, dt, dq))
        cur = (t + n + dt, q + n + dq)
ACGT = np.array(list(b'ACGT'), dtype=np.uint8)
rows = []
covered = 0
for c in chains:
    for t, q, n, dt, dq in c['blocks']:
        if c['strand'] == '+':
            gstart = q
            ts = T[gstart:gstart+n]
        else:
            gstart = c['qSize'] - q - n
            ts = T[gstart:gstart+n][::-1].translate(comp)
        ss = S[t:t+n]
        sa = np.frombuffer(ss, dtype=np.uint8)
        ta = np.frombuffer(ts, dtype=np.uint8)
        valid = np.isin(sa, ACGT) & np.isin(ta, ACGT)
        covered += int(valid.sum())
        for j in np.where(valid & (sa != ta))[0]:
            g = gstart + (n-1-j if c['strand'] == '-' else j)
            tb = comp[T[g]] if c['strand'] == '-' else T[g]
            rows.append((c['id'], t+j+1, g+1, chr(S[t+j]), chr(tb)))
print('chain blocks', sum(len(c['blocks']) for c in chains))
print('aligned nonN bases', covered)
print('true reference mismatches', len(rows))
for x in rows:
    print('MM chain=%d src=%d tgt=%d src_ref=%s target_ref=%s' % x)
# Overlap with explicit source REF spans.
covered_spans = []
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
    covered_spans.append((r.pos-1, r.pos-1+len(r.ref), r.pos, r.ref, ','.join(r.alts)))
covered_spans.sort()
inside = []
for row in rows:
    src0 = row[1]-1
    i = bisect.bisect_right([x[0] for x in covered_spans], src0)-1
    if i >= 0 and src0 < covered_spans[i][1]:
        inside.append((row, covered_spans[i]))
print('mismatches inside explicit REF spans', len(inside))
for row, span in inside:
    print('OVERLAP mismatch=%s record_pos=%d record_ref=%s record_alts=%s' % (row, span[2], span[3], span[4]))
PY

Analysis: The split output has complete source FORMAT fields and no missing source values. A key example shows provider `G>A` becoming GRCh38 `A>G`; the plugin preserves `0/1`, so its genotype must be checked against source copy semantics, especially when source REF becomes the target ALT. The sorted split-lift VCF is now indexed and available for systematic inspection.
Plan: Inspect the plugin's INFO definitions and compare source genotypes to lifted genotypes for allele swaps. Examine duplicate source-allele mappings and representative multiallelic records to determine how each target ALT maps to a source REF or ALT copy.

import pysam
src={}
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/tmp/split.vcf'):
    src[(int(r.pos),r.ref,r.alts[0])]=[(s,list(r.samples[s]['GT']),list(r.samples[s]['AD'])) for s in r.samples]
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/tmp/split_lift.sorted.vcf.gz'):
    sp=int(r.info['SRC_POS']); sr,sa=r.info['SRC_REF_ALT']
    k=(sp,sr,sa)
    sg=src.get(k)
    if sg is None:
        continue
    target_ref_is_source_alt = (r.ref==sa)
    target_alt_is_source_ref = (r.alts[0]==sr)
    target_alt_is_source_alt = (r.alts[0]==sa)
    if target_ref_is_source_alt or target_alt_is_source_ref:
        outgt=[(s,list(r.samples[s]['GT'])) for s in r.samples]
        source_alt_copies=[sum(x==1 for x in g if x is not None) for _,g,_ in sg]
        source_ref_copies=[sum(x==0 for x in g if x is not None) for _,g,_ in sg]
        output_alt_copies=[sum(x==1 for x in g if x is not None) for _,g in outgt]
        interesting=any(a!=b for a,b in zip(output_alt_copies,source_alt_copies)) or target_alt_is_source_ref
        if interesting:
            print('SRC',k,'SRC_GT',[(x[0],x[1]) for x in sg],
                  'TGT',r.pos,r.ref,r.alts[0],'TGT_GT',outgt,
                  'srcRefCopies',source_ref_copies,'srcAltCopies',source_alt_copies,
                  'SWAP',r.info.get('SWAP','.'))
PY

The split-lift output also shows that post-liftover normalization can change coordinates without updating its provenance fields, so the definitive converter should map alleles directly from the corrected chain blocks rather than rely on provenance after normalization.
Plan: Quantify direct chain overlaps, target-N exposure, and duplicate source alignments using the corrected parser. Then create synthetic one-allele records for each source REF and ALT, lift them without post-normalization, and compare the resulting target alleles to direct chain mapping. This will provide a reliable explicit-allele mapping before writing the final VCF.

import pysam, bisect
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
chains=[]; cur=None
for line in open('/task/input/resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain'):
    p=line.split()
    if not p: continue
    if p[0]=='chain':
        chains.append({'id':int(p[12]),'tStart':int(p[5]),'qStart':int(p[10]),'qSize':int(p[8]),'strand':p[9],'blocks':[]}); cur=None
    else:
        n=int(p[0]); dt=int(p[1]) if len(p)>1 else 0; dq=int(p[2]) if len(p)>2 else 0
        c=chains[-1]; t,q=cur if cur is not None else (c['tStart'],c['qStart'])
        c['blocks'].append((t,q,n,dt,dq)); cur=(t+n+dt,q+n+dq)
blocks=[]
for c in chains:
    for t,q,n,dt,dq in c['blocks']:
        g=q if c['strand']=='+' else c['qSize']-q-n
        blocks.append((t,t+n,g,c['strand'],c['qSize'],c['id']))
blocks.sort(); starts=[x[0] for x in blocks]
faT=pysam.FastaFile('/task/input/resources/GRCh38.chr22.fa.gz')
unmapped=[]; ntarget=[]; multi=[]
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
    a=r.pos-1; b=a+len(r.ref); i=bisect.bisect_right(starts,a)-1; hits=[]
    while i>=0 and i<len(blocks) and blocks[i][0]<b:
        x=blocks[i]
        if x[1]>a and x[0] < b: hits.append(x)
        i+=1
    if not hits:
        unmapped.append((r.pos,r.ref,','.join(r.alts)))
    elif len(hits)>1:
        multi.append((r.pos,r.ref,','.join(r.alts),len(hits)))
    else:
        x=hits[0]
        for p in range(a,b):
            g=x[2]+(x[1]-1-p if x[3]=='-' else p-x[0])
            if faT.fetch('chr22',g,g+1).upper()=='N':
                ntarget.append((r.pos,p+1,g+1))
counts=Counter()
for t0,t1,g,strand,qsize,cid in blocks:
    counts.update(range(t0,t1))
print('aligned block bases',sum(counts.values()),'unique source bases',len(counts),'duplicated bases',sum(v-1 for v in counts.values()),'max copies',max(counts.values()))
print('records no chain hit',len(unmapped),'multiple chain hits',len(multi))
print('multiple examples',multi[:30])
print('input REF bases mapping to target N',len(ntarget),'records',len(set(x[0] for x in ntarget)))
print('target-N examples',ntarget[:40])
PY

steps.message:
Analysis: The split-lift experiment showed why alleles should be lifted from the original multiallelic records: splitting first creates duplicate target representations when a provider REF allele itself differs from the GRCh38 reference. The corrected chain mapping is now reliable, all source bases have at most one chain alignment, and no mapped input REF base reaches target N. The next step is to build the final VCF from the normalized original-record liftover plus the 95 implicit assembly-reference substitutions outside explicit record spans.
Plan: Inspect duplicate target keys and rejection rows, then write a Python builder that adds implicit 1/1 records for uncovered assembly-reference differences, merges exact allele duplicates after normalization, and produces a clean sorted bgzipped VCF with `GT:AD:DP:GQ`. Finally validate REF consistency, allele count, sorting, indexing, and FORMAT representation.

cat > /tmp/build_final.py <<'PY'
import re, bisect, pysam
from collections import defaultdict

faT = pysam.FastaFile('/task/input/resources/GRCh38.chr22.fa.gz')
T = faT.fetch('chr22').upper().encode()
comp = bytes.maketrans(b'ACGT', b'TGCA')

# Parse chain with gaps applied after each aligned block.
chains=[]
cur=None
for line in open('/task/input/resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain'):
    p=line.split()
    if not p:
        continue
    if p[0]=='chain':
        c={'id':int(p[12]),'tStart':int(p[5]),'qStart':int(p[10]),
           'qSize':int(p[8]),'strand':p[9],'blocks':[]}
        chains.append(c); cur=None
    else:
        n=int(p[0]); dt=int(p[1]) if len(p)>1 else 0; dq=int(p[2]) if len(p)>2 else 0
        c=chains[-1]
        t,q=cur if cur is not None else (c['tStart'],c['qStart'])
        c['blocks'].append((t,q,n,dt,dq))
        cur=(t+n+dt,q+n+dq)
blocks=[]
for c in chains:
    for t,q,n,dt,dq in c['blocks']:
        g=q if c['strand']=='+' else c['qSize']-q-n
        blocks.append((t,t+n,g,c['strand'],c['id']))
blocks.sort()
block_starts=[x[0] for x in blocks]

def map_base(src1):
    src0=src1-1
    i=bisect.bisect_right(block_starts,src0)-1
    if i<0:
        return None
    a,b,g,strand,cid=blocks[i]
    if src0>=b:
        return None
    j=src0-a
    gpos=g+(b-a-1-j if strand=='-' else j)
    return gpos,strand,cid

# True provider-reference / GRCh38-reference differences.
mism=[]
rx=re.compile(r'MM chain=(\d+) src=(\d+) tgt=(\d+) src_ref=([ACGT]) target_ref=([ACGT])')
for line in open('/tmp/true_mismatches.out'):
    m=rx.match(line)
    if m:
        cid,s,t,sr,tr=m.groups()
        mism.append((int(cid),int(s),int(t),sr,tr))
assert len(mism)==178, len(mism)

# A provider-reference difference inside an explicit REF span is represented by the lifted record.
spans=[]
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
    spans.append((r.pos, r.pos+len(r.ref)-1))
spans.sort()
span_starts=[x[0] for x in spans]
def covered_by_record(src1):
    i=bisect.bisect_right(span_starts,src1)-1
    return i>=0 and src1<=spans[i][1]

records={}
def add_record(pos,ref,alt,gt,ad=None,dp=None,gq=None):
    key=('chr22',int(pos),ref.upper(),alt.upper())
    item={'gt':[0 if x==0 else 1 for x in gt], 'ad':ad, 'dp':dp, 'gq':gq}
    if key not in records:
        records[key]=[item]
    else:
        records[key].append(item)

# Explicit lifted records from original multiallelic records, already split to one ALT.
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/tmp/lift.vcf'):
    assert len(r.alts)==1
    gt=r.samples['F4955-29']['GT']
    copies=sum(x==1 for x in gt if x is not None)
    outgt=[copies,2-copies] if copies in (0,1,2) else [0,2]
    for s in r.samples:
        g=r.samples[s]['GT']
        copies=sum(x==1 for x in g if x is not None)
        assert copies in (0,1,2), (r.pos,r.ref,r.alts,s,g)
    ad=[]
    for s in r.samples:
        x=r.samples[s]['AD']
        if x is None:
            ad.append('.')
        elif len(x)==2:
            ad.append(','.join('.' if v is None else str(v) for v in x))
        else:
            # If any stale multiallelic AD remains, use the first REF and first ALT fields.
            ad.append(','.join('.' if x[i] is None else str(x[i]) for i in (0,1)))
    add_record(r.pos,r.ref,r.alts[0],
               [sum(x==1 for x in r.samples[s]['GT'] if x is not None) for s in r.samples],
               ad,
               [r.samples[s]['DP'] for s in r.samples],
               [r.samples[s]['GQ'] for s in r.samples])

# Implicit records: all three are homozygous for the provider reference.
implicit=[]
for cid,spos,tpos,sr,tr in mism:
    mapped=map_base(spos)
    assert mapped is not None, ('unmapped mismatch',spos)
    g,strand,mcid=mapped
    assert g+1==tpos, (spos,tpos,g+1)
    target_ref=chr(T[g])
    provider_in_target=chr(comp[ord(sr)]) if strand=='-' else sr
    if provider_in_target==target_ref:
        continue
    if covered_by_record(spos):
        continue
    add_record(g+1,target_ref,provider_in_target,[2,2,2])
    implicit.append((g+1,target_ref,provider_in_target))
print('explicit normalized records',sum(1 for r in pysam.VariantFile('/tmp/lift.vcf')))
print('implicit records',len(implicit))
print('pre-merge unique keys',len(records),'duplicate keys',sum(len(v)>1 for v in records.values()))

header_lines=[]
header_lines.append('##fileformat=VCFv4.2')
header_lines.append('##FILTER=<ID=PASS,Description="All filters passed">')
header_lines.append('##contig=<ID=chr22,length=50818468>')
header_lines.append('##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Copy count as diploid genotype">')
header_lines.append('##FORMAT=<ID=AD,Number=R,Type=Integer,Description="Allelic depths for GRCh38 REF and ALT alleles">')
header_lines.append('##FORMAT=<ID=DP,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Read depth">')
header_lines.append('##FORMAT=<ID=GQ,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Genotype quality">')
header_lines.append('#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\tF4955-78\tF4955-29\tF4955-67')
with open('/tmp/final_preflight.vcf','w') as o:
    for line in header_lines:
        o.write(line+'\n')
    for (_,pos,ref,alt),items in sorted(records.items(),key=lambda x:(x[0][1],x[0][2],x[0][3])):
        # For exact target-allele duplicates, copy counts are additive and capped at diploid copy number.
        gt=[]
        for si in range(3):
            n=min(2,sum(x['gt'][si] for x in items))
            gt.append(f'{n}/{n}' if n in (0,2) else '0/1')
        # Keep the first complete FORMAT row; exact collapsed representations do not have a unique read partition.
        vals=items[0]
        fmt='GT'
        fields=[gt[0],gt[1],gt[2]]
        if vals['dp'] is not None or vals['ad'] is not None or vals['gq'] is not None:
            fmt='GT:AD:DP:GQ'
            for si in range(3):
                ad=vals['ad'][si] if vals['ad'] is not None else '.'
                dp=vals['dp'][si] if vals['dp'] is not None else '.'
                gq=vals['gq'][si] if vals['gq'] is not None else '.'
                fields[si]+=f':{ad}:{dp}:{gq}'
        o.write('\t'.join(['chr22',str(pos),'.',ref,alt,'.','PASS','.',fmt,*fields])+'\n')

We also need remove any target record with zero carriers and correct `unmapped.tsv` to use the input allele's aligned anchor position rather than requiring the whole REF span to be in one block.
Plan: Inspect plugin genotype semantics, count all-zero lifted records, and query representative transformed loci. Then rebuild the final VCF directly from plugin target records, retaining their correctly transformed GT/FORMAT, filtering zero-carrier records, and adding only implicit provider-reference differences outside covered input spans. We will also regenerate `unmapped.tsv` using the input anchor position.

cat > /tmp/rebuild_final.py <<'PY'
import re, bisect, pysam

faT=pysam.FastaFile('/task/input/resources/GRCh38.chr22.fa.gz')
T=faT.fetch('chr22').upper().encode()

# Parse chain with gaps applied after each block.
chains=[]
cur=None
for line in open('/task/input/resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain'):
    p=line.split()
    if not p:
        continue
    if p[0]=='chain':
        c={'tStart':int(p[5]),'qStart':int(p[10]),'qSize':int(p[8]),
           'strand':p[9],'blocks':[]}
        chains.append(c); cur=None
    else:
        n=int(p[0]); dt=int(p[1]) if len(p)>1 else 0; dq=int(p[2]) if len(p)>2 else 0
        c=chains[-1]
        t,q=cur if cur is not None else (c['tStart'],c['qStart'])
        c['blocks'].append((t,q,n))
        cur=(t+n+dt,q+n+dq)
blocks=[]
for c in chains:
    for t,q,n in c['blocks']:
        g=q if c['strand']=='+' else c['qSize']-q-n
        blocks.append((t,t+n,g,c['strand']))
blocks.sort()
starts=[x[0] for x in blocks]
def map_base(p1):
    p0=p1-1
    i=bisect.bisect_right(starts,p0)-1
    if i<0: return None
    a,b,g,strand=blocks[i]
    if p0>=b: return None
    j=p0-a
    return g+(b-a-1-j if strand=='-' else j)

# Provider-reference differences inside a source REF span are represented by lifted records.
spans=[]
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
    spans.append((r.pos,r.pos+len(r.ref)-1))
spans.sort(); span_starts=[x[0] for x in spans]
def covered(p1):
    i=bisect.bisect_right(span_starts,p1)-1
    return i>=0 and p1<=spans[i][1]

records=[]
seen=set()
# Use target GT produced by bcftools +liftover; it counts copies of each transformed target ALT.
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/tmp/lift.vcf'):
    assert len(r.alts)==1
    gt=[]
    for s in r.samples:
        copies=sum(x==1 for x in r.samples[s]['GT'] if x is not None)
        assert copies in (0,1,2),(r.pos,r.ref,r.alts[0],s,r.samples[s]['GT'])
        gt.append(copies)
    if sum(gt)==0:
        continue
    ad=[]
    for s in r.samples:
        x=r.samples[s]['AD']
        if x is None:
            ad.append('.')
        else:
            ad.append(','.join('.' if v is None else str(v) for v in x))
    vals=['.','.'']
    key=(r.pos,r.ref,r.alts[0])
    if key in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(key)
    records.append({'pos':r.pos,'ref':r.ref,'alt':r.alts[0],
                    'gt':gt,'ad':ad,
                    'dp':[r.samples[s]['DP'] for s in r.samples],
                    'gq':[r.samples[s]['GQ'] for s in r.samples]})

# Add implicit differences at positions without an input record.
rx=re.compile(r'MM chain=(\d+) src=(\d+) tgt=(\d+) src_ref=([ACGT]) target_ref=([ACGT])')
implicit=[]
for line in open('/tmp/true_mismatches.out'):
    m=rx.match(line)
    if not m:
        continue
    cid,spos,tpos,sref,tref=m.groups(); spos=int(spos); tpos=int(tpos)
    if covered(spos):
        continue
    g=map_base(spos)
    assert g is not None and g+1==tpos,(spos,tpos,g)
    ref=chr(T[g]).upper()
    # Provider source base in target genomic orientation.
    strand=blocks[bisect.bisect_right(starts,spos-1)-1][3]
    comp=bytes.maketrans(b'ACGT',b'TGCA')
    alt=chr(comp[ord(sref)]) if strand=='-' else sref
    if ref==alt:
        continue
    key=(tpos,ref,alt)
    if key in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(key)
    records.append({'pos':tpos,'ref':ref,'alt':alt,'gt':[2,2,2],
                    'ad':None,'dp':None,'gq':None})
    implicit.append(key)

print('plugin carrier records',sum(1 for x in records if x['ad'] is not None))
print('implicit records',len(implicit))
print('total records',len(records))
assert len({(x['pos'],x['ref'],x['alt']) for x in records})==len(records)

with open('/tmp/rebuilt_final.vcf','w') as o:
    o.write('##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n')
    o.write('##FILTER=<ID=PASS,Description="All filters passed">\n')
    o.write('##contig=<ID=chr22,length=50818468>\n')
    o.write('##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Copy count as diploid genotype">\n')
    o.write('##FORMAT=<ID=AD,Number=R,Type=Integer,Description="Allelic depths for GRCh38 REF and ALT alleles">\n')
    o.write('##FORMAT=<ID=DP,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Read depth">\n')
    o.write('##FORMAT=<ID=GQ,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Genotype quality">\n')
    o.write('#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\tF4955-78\tF4955-29\tF4955-67\n')
    for x in sorted(records,key=lambda y:(y['pos'],y['ref'],y['alt'])):
        gt=[]
        for n in x['gt']:
            gt.append(f'{n}/{n}' if n in (0,2) else '0/1')
        fields=gt[:]
        if x['ad'] is not None:
            fmt='GT:AD:DP:GQ'
            for i in range(3):
                fields[i]+=f":{x['ad'][i]}:{x['dp'][i]}:{x['gq'][i]}"
        else:
            fmt='GT:AD:DP:GQ'
            fields=[v+':.:.:.' for v in gt]
        o.write('\t'.join(['chr22',str(x['pos']),'.',x['ref'],x['alt'],'.','PASS','.',fmt,*fields])+'\n')
PY

Plan: Inspect all normalized records and duplicate keys, then generate a detailed table for every covered assembly-reference mismatch showing the source record, whether each source allele contains the provider-reference base, the target reference/ALT, and any corresponding lifted record. import re, bisect, pysam
from collections import defaultdict

comp = bytes.maketrans(b'ACGT', b'TGCA')
faS = pysam.FastaFile('/task/input/resources/GRCh37.chr22.fa.gz')
faT = pysam.FastaFile('/task/input/resources/GRCh38.chr22.fa.gz')
S = faS.fetch('chr22').upper().encode()
T = faT.fetch('chr22').upper().encode()

# Correct chain parser and coordinate map.
chains=[]; cur=None
for line in open('/task/input/resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain'):
    p=line.split()
    if not p:
        continue
    if p[0]=='chain':
        chains.append({'id':int(p[12]),'tStart':int(p[5]),'qStart':int(p[10]),
                       'qSize':int(p[8]),'strand':p[9],'blocks':[]})
        cur=None
    else:
        n=int(p[0]); dt=int(p[1]) if len(p)>1 else 0; dq=int(p[2]) if len(p)>2 else 0
        c=chains[-1]
        t,q=cur if cur is not None else (c['tStart'],c['qStart'])
        c['blocks'].append((t,t+n,q,q+n,c['id'],c['strand']))
        cur=(t+n+dt,q+n+dq)
blocks=[]
for c in chains:
    for a,b,q0,q1,cid,strand in c['blocks']:
        g0=q0 if strand=='+' else c['qSize']-q1
        blocks.append((a,b,g0,strand,cid))
blocks.sort(); starts=[x[0] for x in blocks]
def map_source(p1):
    i=bisect.bisect_right(starts,p1-1)-1
    if i<0: return None
    a,b,g0,strand,cid=blocks[i]
    if p1-1 >= b: return None
    j=p1-1-a
    g=g0+(b-a-1-j if strand=='-' else j)
    return g,strand,cid

# Parse true mismatches.
rx=re.compile(r'MM chain=(\d+) src=(\d+) tgt=(\d+) src_ref=([ACGT]) target_ref=([ACGT])')
mism=[]
for line in open('/tmp/true_mismatches.out'):
    m=rx.match(line)
    if m:
        cid,s,t,a,b=m.groups()
        mism.append((int(cid),int(s),int(t),a,b))

# Source records and lifted records, both held in memory.
source=[]
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
    source.append((r.pos,r.pos+len(r.ref)-1,r))
source.sort()
source_starts=[x[0] for x in source]
lift=[]
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/tmp/lift.vcf'):
    ref,alts=r.info['SRC_REF_ALT']
    lift.append((int(r.info['SRC_POS']),int(r.info['SRC_POS'])+len(ref)-1,r))

covered=0
for cid,spos,tpos,sref,tref in mism:
    i=bisect.bisect_right(source_starts,spos)-1
    if i<0 or spos>source[i][1]:
        continue
    covered += 1
    pos,end,r=source[i]
    g,strand,mcid=map_source(spos)
    assert g+1==tpos and S[spos-1:spos].decode()==sref
    target_ref=chr(T[g]) if strand=='+' else chr(comp[T[g]])
    assert target_ref==tref
    provider_target=chr(comp[ord(sref)]) if strand=='-' else sref
    offset=spos-pos
    allele_has_provider=[]
    for seq in [r.ref]+list(r.alts):
        allele_has_provider.append(offset < len(seq) and seq[offset]==sref)
    # Copy count of provider-reference target allele from source genotypes.
    counts=[]
    for s in r.samples:
        gt=r.samples[s]['GT']
        n=sum(allele_has_provider[x] for x in gt if x is not None and x < len(allele_has_provider))
        counts.append(n)
    matches=[]
    for ls,le,lr in lift:
        if ls<=spos<=le and lr.pos==tpos:
            matches.append((lr.pos,lr.ref,','.join(lr.alts),int(lr.info['SRC_POS']),','.join(lr.info['SRC_REF_ALT']),lr.info.get('SWAP','.'),[(s,lr.samples[s]['GT']) for s in lr.samples]))
    print(f'CASE src={spos} target={tpos} provider_to_target={sref}>{provider_target} target_ref={tref} record={pos}/{r.ref}/{",".join(r.alts)} allele_has_provider={allele_has_provider} provider_GT={counts} matches={matches}')
print('covered mismatches',covered)

import bisect, pysam

faS = pysam.FastaFile('/task/input/resources/GRCh37.chr22.fa.gz')
faT = pysam.FastaFile('/task/input/resources/GRCh38.chr22.fa.gz')
S = faS.fetch('chr22').upper().encode()
T = faT.fetch('chr22').upper().encode()
comp = bytes.maketrans(b'ACGTN', b'TGCAN')

# Parse chain blocks; gaps apply after each aligned block.
chains = []
cur = None
for line in open('/task/input/resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain'):
    p = line.split()
    if not p:
        continue
    if p[0] == 'chain':
        chains.append({'tStart': int(p[5]), 'qStart': int(p[10]),
                       'qSize': int(p[8]), 'strand': p[9], 'blocks': []})
        cur = None
    else:
        n = int(p[0]); dt = int(p[1]) if len(p) > 1 else 0
        dq = int(p[2]) if len(p) > 2 else 0
        c = chains[-1]
        t, q = cur if cur is not None else (c['tStart'], c['qStart'])
        c['blocks'].append((t, t+n, q, q+n))
        cur = (t+n+dt, q+n+dq)

blocks = []
for c in chains:
    for a, b, q0, q1 in c['blocks']:
        g0 = q0 if c['strand'] == '+' else c['qSize'] - q1
        blocks.append((a, b, g0, c['strand'], c['qSize']))
blocks.sort()
block_starts = [x[0] for x in blocks]

def containing_block(src0):
    i = bisect.bisect_right(block_starts, src0) - 1
    if i < 0:
        return None
    x = blocks[i]
    return x if src0 < x[1] else None

def trim_common(ref, alt):
    p = 0
    while p < min(len(ref), len(alt)) and ref[p] == alt[p]:
        p += 1
    rrem = ref[p:]; arem = alt[p:]
    q = 0
    while q < min(len(rrem), len(arem)) and rrem[-1-q] == arem[-1-q]:
        q += 1
    return p, q

def project_record(rec):
    src0 = rec.pos - 1
    b = containing_block(src0)
    if b is None or src0 + len(rec.ref) > b[1]:
        return None
    a, bend, g0, strand, qsize = b
    R = len(rec.ref)
    if strand == '+':
        target_start = g0 + (src0 - a)
    else:
        target_start = g0 + (bend - a - (src0 - a) - R)
    target_ref = T[target_start:target_start+R].decode()
    projected = {}
    for role, alt in [('REF', rec.ref)] + [(f'ALT{j}', x) for j, x in enumerate(rec.alts, 1)]:
        p, q = trim_common(rec.ref, alt)
        prefix = alt[:p]
        core = alt[p:len(alt)-q]
        suffix = alt[len(alt)-q:] if q else ''
        if strand == '+':
            seq = prefix + core + suffix
        else:
            seq = (prefix.translate(comp) + core.translate(comp) + suffix.translate(comp))[::-1]
        projected[role] = seq
    return {'src_pos': rec.pos, 'src_ref': rec.ref, 'src_alts': list(rec.alts),
            'target_start1': target_start+1, 'target_ref': target_ref,
            'projected': projected, 'strand': strand}

# Create one normalized-format record for every projected source allele.
header = ['##fileformat=VCFv4.2',
          '##FILTER=<ID=PASS,Description="All filters passed">',
          '##contig=<ID=chr22,length=50818468>',
          '##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Genotype copy count">',
          '##FORMAT=<ID=AD,Number=R,Type=Integer,Description="Allelic depths">',
          '##FORMAT=<ID=DP,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Read depth">',

It contains 17 zero-carrier records that must be removed, and four records lifted across one-base chain gaps must also be excluded because the chain does not align their anchors. Plan: Build the definitive final VCF from the normalized original-record liftover, filtering unaligned-anchor and zero-carrier records, adding implicit 1/1 assembly-difference records, sorting and indexing. import bisect, pysam

# Parse chain blocks exactly as written: gap fields follow each aligned block.
chains=[]
cur=None
for line in open('/task/input/resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain'):
    p=line.split()
    if not p:
        continue
    if p[0]=='chain':
        chains.append({'tStart':int(p[5]),'qStart':int(p[10]),'blocks':[]})
        cur=None
    else:
        n=int(p[0]); dt=int(p[1]) if len(p)>1 else 0; dq=int(p[2]) if len(p)>2 else 0
        c=chains[-1]
        t,q=cur if cur is not None else (c['tStart'],c['qStart'])
        c['blocks'].append((t,t+n))
        cur=(t+n+dt,q+n+dq)
blocks=sorted((a,b) for c in chains for a,b in c['blocks'])
starts=[a for a,b in blocks]
def aligned_anchor(pos1):
    p0=pos1-1
    i=bisect.bisect_right(starts,p0)-1
    return i>=0 and p0<blocks[i][1]

unaligned=set()
with open('/task/output/unmapped.tsv','w') as o:
    o.write('chrom_in\tpos_in\tref\talt\n')
    for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
        if not aligned_anchor(r.pos):
            unaligned.add(r.pos)
            for alt in r.alts:
                o.write(f'{r.chrom}\t{r.pos}\t{r.ref}\t{alt}\n')
print('unmapped ALT rows',sum(1 for _ in open('/task/output/unmapped.tsv'))-1,'source positions',len(unaligned))

records=[]
seen=set()
explicit=dropped_unaligned=dropped_zero=0
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/tmp/lift.vcf'):
    assert len(r.alts)==1
    srcpos=int(r.info['SRC_POS'])
    if srcpos in unaligned:
        dropped_unaligned += 1
        continue
    gt=[]
    for s in r.samples:
        copies=sum(x==1 for x in r.samples[s]['GT'] if x is not None)
        assert copies in (0,1,2),(r.pos,r.ref,r.alts[0],s,r.samples[s]['GT'])
        gt.append(copies)
    if sum(gt)==0:
        dropped_zero += 1
        continue
    ad=[]
    for s in r.samples:
        x=r.samples[s]['AD']
        ad.append('.' if x is None else ','.join('.' if v is None else str(v) for v in x))
    key=('chr22',r.pos,r.ref.upper(),r.alts[0].upper())
    assert key not in seen,(r.pos,r.ref,r.alts[0])
    seen.add(key)
    records.append((r.pos,r.ref,r.alts[0],gt,ad,
                    [r.samples[s]['DP'] for s in r.samples],
                    [r.samples[s]['GQ'] for s in r.samples]))
    explicit += 1

# Provider-reference differences at positions not covered by any input record.
import re
spans=[]
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
    spans.append((r.pos,r.pos+len(r.ref)-1))
spans.sort(); span_starts=[x[0] for x in spans]
def covered(pos1):
    i=bisect.bisect_right(span_starts,pos1)-1
    return i>=0 and pos1<=spans[i][1]

faT=pysam.FastaFile('/task/input/resources/GRCh38.chr22.fa.gz')
comp=bytes.maketrans(b'ACGT',b'TGCA')
# Rebuild genomic target starts for the corrected chain blocks.
chain2=[]; cur=None
for line in open('/task/input/resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain'):
    p=line.split()
    if not p:
        continue
    if p[0]=='chain':
        chain2.append({'tStart':int(p[5]),'qStart':int(p[10]),'qSize':int(p[8]),'strand':p[9],'blocks':[]})
        cur=None
    else:
        n=int(p[0]); dt=int(p[1]) if len(p)>1 else 0; dq=int(p[2]) if len(p)>2 else 0
        c=chain2[-1]
        t,q=cur if cur is not None else (c['tStart'],c['qStart'])
        c['blocks'].append((t,t+n,q,q+n))
        cur=(t+n+dt,q+n+dq)
mapblocks=[]
for c in chain2:
    for a,b,q0,q1 in c['blocks']:
        g0=q0 if c['strand']=='+' else c['qSize']-q1
        mapblocks.append((a,b,g0,c['strand']))
mapblocks.sort(); mapstarts=[x[0] for x in mapblocks]
def target_pos(src1):
    p0=src1-1
    i=bisect.bisect_right(mapstarts,p0)-1
    if i<0: return None
    a,b,g0,strand=mapblocks[i]
    if p0>=b: return None
    j=p0-a
    return g0+(b-a-1-j if strand=='-' else j),strand

implicit=0
rx=re.compile(r'MM chain=(\d+) src=(\d+) tgt=(\d+) src_ref=([ACGT]) target_ref=([ACGT])')
for line in open('/tmp/true_mismatches.out'):
    m=rx.match(line)

    records.append((tpos,ref,alt,[2,2,2],None,None,None))
    implicit += 1

print('explicit retained',explicit,'dropped unaligned',dropped_unaligned,'dropped zero-carrier',dropped_zero,'implicit added',implicit,'total',len(records))
with open('/tmp/definitive.vcf','w') as o:
    o.write('##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n')
    o.write('##FILTER=<ID=PASS,Description="All filters passed">\n')
    o.write('##contig=<ID=chr22,length=50818468>\n')
    o.write('##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Number of chromosome copies carrying ALT (0/0, 0/1, or 1/1)">\n')
    o.write('##FORMAT=<ID=AD,Number=R,Type=Integer,Description="Allelic depths for GRCh38 REF and ALT">\n')
    o.write('##FORMAT=<ID=DP,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Read depth">\n')
    o.write('##FORMAT=<ID=GQ,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Genotype quality">\n')
    o.write('#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\tF4955-78\tF4955-29\tF4955-67\n')
    for pos,ref,alt,gt,ad,dp,gq in sorted(records,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1],x[2])):
        cells=[]
        for i in range(3):
            n=gt[i]
            base=f'{n}/{n}' if n in (0,2) else '0/1'
            if ad is None:
                cells.append(base)
            else:

steps.message:
Analysis: The definitive VCF is now structurally valid with 3,095 records, one ALT per record, no duplicates, no all-zero records, and REF consistency confirmed. However, `unmapped.tsv` incorrectly contains four alleles whose anchors are exactly at the start of the next chain block; the true count should be 27, matching the plugin rejections. We also need verify which assembly-reference differences overlap multi-base REF spans before candidate annotation.
Plan: Correct the anchor-alignment check to consider the next chain block, regenerate `unmapped.tsv`, inspect the definitive build log and mismatch offsets within source REF spans, and summarize final VCF genotypes and usable FORMAT fields. This will finalize the call set and prepare for transcript consequence annotation.

arguments.keystrokes:
printf '%s\n' '--- definitive build log ---'
cat /tmp/build_definitive.log

cat > /tmp/fix_unmapped.py <<'PY'
import bisect, pysam
chains=[]
cur=None
for line in open('/task/input/resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain'):
    p=line.split()
    if not p:
        continue
    if p[0]=='chain':
        chains.append({'tStart':int(p[5]),'qStart':int(p[10]),'blocks':[]})
        cur=None
    else:
        n=int(p[0]); dt=int(p[1]) if len(p)>1 else 0; dq=int(p[2]) if len(p)>2 else 0
        c=chains[-1]
        t,q=cur if cur is not None else (c['tStart'],c['qStart'])
        c['blocks'].append((t,t+n))
        cur=(t+n+dt,q+n+dq)
blocks=sorted((a,b) for c in chains for a,b in c['blocks'])
starts=[a for a,b in blocks]
def aligned_anchor(pos1):
    p0=pos1-1
    for a,b in blocks:
        if a <= p0 < b:
            return True
    return False
with open('/task/output/unmapped.tsv','w') as o:
    o.write('chrom_in\tpos_in\tref\talt\n')
    for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
        if not aligned_anchor(r.pos):
            for alt in r.alts:
                o.write(f'{r.chrom}\t{r.pos}\t{r.ref}\t{alt}\n')
PY
python3 /tmp/fix_unmapped.py
printf 'unmapped rows='; awk 'END{print NR-1}' /task/output/unmapped.tsv
printf '%s\n' '--- excluded positions versus plugin rejections ---'
tail -n +2 /task/output/unmapped.tsv | cut -f2 | sort > /tmp/unmapped.pos
bcftools view -H /tmp/lift.rej | cut -f2 | sort > /tmp/rejected.pos
printf 'unmapped only: '; comm -23 /tmp/unmapped.pos /tmp/rejected.pos
printf 'rejected only: '; comm -13 /tmp/unmapped.pos /tmp/rejected.pos

cat > /tmp/mismatch_offsets.py <<'PY'
import re,bisect,pysam
from collections import Counter
rx=re.compile(r'MM chain=(\d+) src=(\d+) tgt=(\d+) src_ref=([ACGT]) target_ref=([ACGT])')
mism=[]
for line in open('/tmp/true_mismatches.out'):
    m=rx.match(line)
    if m:
        c,s,t,a,b=m.groups(); mism.append((int(s),int(t),a,b))
spans=[]
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
    spans.append((r.pos,r.pos+len(r.ref)-1,r))
spans.sort(); starts=[x[0] for x in spans]
inside=[]
for spos,tpos,sr,tr in mism:
    i=bisect.bisect_right(starts,spos)-1
    if i>=0 and spos<=spans[i][1]:
        r=spans[i][2]
        inside.append((spos,tpos,sr,tr,r.pos,r.ref,','.join(r.alts),spos-r.pos,len(r.ref)))
print('inside source REF spans',len(inside))
print('offset counts',Counter(x[7] for x in inside))
print('records with mismatch beyond first base',[(x[0],x[5],x[6],x[7],x[8]) for x in inside if x[7]>0])
print('all inside cases:')
for x in inside: print('INSIDE',*x)
PY
python3 /tmp/mismatch_offsets.py > /tmp/mismatch_offsets.out
head -8 /tmp/mismatch_offsets.out
tail -100 /tmp/mismatch_offsets.out

steps.message:
Analysis: The current VCF still uses plugin genotypes, which are not valid when the provider reference allele itself becomes a non-reference GRCh38 allele. For example, a source `T>A` record homozygous for provider `T` maps to GRCh38 `A>T`, so all three samples must be `1/1`, but the plugin emitted `0/0`. The final converter must reconstruct target genotypes from source REF/ALT roles. The 31-row unmapped table is consistent with the raw chain gaps; four records lifted by the plugin cross one-base gaps and must remain excluded.
Plan: Build a definitive role-aware converter. It will use raw plugin-transformed ALT alleles for sequence representation, directly project provider-reference alleles, derive GRCh38 copy counts and allele-specific depths from the original multiallelic source records, drop unaligned or non-carried alleles, and add the 95 implicit assembly differences. Then normalize, sort, index, and validate the result.

arguments.keystrokes:
cat > /tmp/build_role_vcf.py <<'PY'
import bisect, re, pysam
from collections import defaultdict

SFA='/task/input/resources/GRCh37.chr22.fa.gz'
TFA='/task/input/resources/GRCh38.chr22.fa.gz'
faS=pysam.FastaFile(SFA)
faT=pysam.FastaFile(TFA)
S=faS.fetch('chr22').upper().encode()
T=faT.fetch('chr22').upper().encode()
comp=str.maketrans('ACGTN','TGCAN')

# Parse raw chain blocks. Chain coordinates are 0-based half-open; gaps follow each block.
chains=[]
cur=None
for line in open('/task/input/resources/hg19ToHg38.chr22.over.chain'):
    p=line.split()
    if not p:
        continue
    if p[0]=='chain':
        chains.append({'tStart':int(p[5]),'qStart':int(p[10]),'qSize':int(p[8]),
                       'strand':p[9],'blocks':[]})
        cur=None
    else:
        n=int(p[0]); dt=int(p[1]) if len(p)>1 else 0
        dq=int(p[2]) if len(p)>2 else 0
        c=chains[-1]
        t,q=cur if cur is not None else (c['tStart'],c['qStart'])
        c['blocks'].append((t,t+n,q,q+n))
        cur=(t+n+dt,q+n+dq)

blocks=[]
for c in chains:
    for a,b,q0,q1 in c['blocks']:
        g0=q0 if c['strand']=='+' else c['qSize']-q1
        blocks.append((a,b,g0,c['strand']))
blocks.sort()
block_starts=[x[0] for x in blocks]

def record_block(pos1,reflen):
    p0=pos1-1
    i=bisect.bisect_right(block_starts,p0)-1
    if i>=0:
        a,b,g0,strand=blocks[i]
        if p0>=a and p0+reflen<=b:
            return a,b,g0,strand
    return None

def target_start(pos1,reflen,a,b,g0,strand):
    j=pos1-1-a
    if strand=='+':
        return g0+j
    return g0+(b-a)-reflen-j

def project_ref(seq,strand):
    if strand=='+':
        return seq.upper()
    return seq.upper()[::-1].translate(comp)

# Load raw, pre-normalization liftover records for each source ALT.
raw_by_src=defaultdict(list)
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/tmp/split_raw_lift.vcf'):
    sr,sa=r.info['SRC_REF_ALT']
    raw_by_src[(int(r.info['SRC_POS']),sr,sa)].append(r)

records=[]
seen=set()
unaligned=[]
with open('/task/output/unmapped.tsv','w') as o:
    o.write('chrom_in\tpos_in\tref\talt\n')
    for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
        if record_block(r.pos,len(r.ref)) is None:
            unaligned.append(r.pos)
            for alt in r.alts:
                o.write(f'{r.chrom}\t{r.pos}\t{r.ref}\t{alt}\n')

explicit_added=explicit_skipped_ref=0
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
    blk=record_block(r.pos,len(r.ref))
    if blk is None:
        continue
    a,b,g0,strand=blk
    R=len(r.ref)
    ts0=target_start(r.pos,R,a,b,g0,strand)
    target_ref=T[ts0:ts0+R].decode().upper()
    provider_ref_alt=project_ref(r.ref,strand)
    raw_alts={}
    for j,sa in enumerate(r.alts,1):
        hits=raw_by_src.get((r.pos,r.ref,sa))
        if len(hits)!=1:
            raise RuntimeError(f'expected one raw lift for {r.pos} {sa}, got {len(hits)}')
        h=hits[0]
        if h.ref.upper()!=target_ref.upper():
            raise RuntimeError(f'target REF mismatch {r.pos}: {h.ref} vs {target_ref}')
        raw_alts[j]=h.alts[0].upper()

    # Map every source allele role to its transformed target allele.
    role_target={0:provider_ref_alt}
    for j in range(1,len(r.alts)+1):
        role_target[j]=raw_alts[j]
    roles_to_target_ref=[j for j,x in role_target.items() if x==target_ref]
    ad_ref=0
    for j in roles_to_target_ref:
        v=r.samples[next(iter(r.samples))]['AD']  # placeholder; added below per sample
    # Per-sample AD sums by target allele.
    sample_names=list(r.samples)
    def ad_for_target(target_seq,si):
        total=0; found=False
        for j,seq in role_target.items():
            if seq==target_seq:
                found=True
                x=r.samples[sample_names[si]]['AD']
                if x is not None and x[j] is not None:
                    total += x[j]
        return total if found else 0

    def add_target_record(target_seq,role):
        if target_seq==target_ref:
            return False
        gt=[]; ads=[]
        for si,s in enumerate(sample_names):
            gtallele=r.samples[s]['GT']
            copies=sum(x==role for x in gtallele if x is not None)
            assert copies in (0,1,2),(r.pos,s,role,gtallele)
            gt.append(copies)
            ads.append(ad_for_target(target_seq,si))
        if sum(gt)==0:
            return False
        key=('chr22',r.pos,target_ref,target_seq)
        if key in seen:
            raise RuntimeError(f'duplicate role record {key}')
        seen.add(key)
        records.append((ts0+1,target_ref,target_seq,gt,ads,
                        [r.samples[s]['DP'] for s in sample_names],
                        [r.samples[s]['GQ'] for s in sample_names]))
        return True

    if add_target_record(provider_ref_alt,0):
        explicit_added += 1
    else:
        explicit_skipped_ref += 1
    for j in range(1,len(r.alts)+1):
        if add_target_record(raw_alts[j],j):
            explicit_added += 1
        else:
            explicit_skipped_ref += 1

# Provider-reference differences outside source record spans are homozygous in all samples.
spans=[]
for r in pysam.VariantFile('/task/input/trio.vcf.gz'):
    spans.append((r.pos,r.pos+len(r.ref)-1))
spans.sort()
span_starts=[x[0] for x in spans]
def covered_by_record(pos1):
    i=bisect.bisect_right(span_starts,pos1)-1
    return i>=0 and pos1<=spans[i][1]

rx=re.compile(r'MM chain=(\d+) src=(\d+) tgt=(\d+) src_ref=([ACGT]) target_ref=([ACGT])')
implicit=[]
for line in open('/tmp/true_mismatches.out'):
    m=rx.match(line)
    if not m:
        continue
    _,spos,tpos,sref,tref=m.groups()
    spos=int(spos); tpos=int(tpos)
    if covered_by_record(spos):
        continue
    p0=spos-1
    i=bisect.bisect_right(block_starts,p0)-1
    if i<0:
        raise RuntimeError(f'unaligned mismatch {spos}')
    a,b,g0,strand=blocks[i]
    if p0>=b:
        raise RuntimeError(f'unaligned mismatch {spos}')
    j=p0-a
    g=g0+(b-a-1-j if strand=='-' else j)
    assert g+1==tpos,(spos,tpos,g+1)
    ref=chr(T[g]).upper()
    alt=chr(comp[ord(sref)]) if strand=='-' else sref
    assert ref==tref,(spos,tpos,ref,tref)
    key=('chr22',tpos,ref,alt)
    if key in seen:
        raise RuntimeError(f'implicit duplicate {key}')
    seen.add(key)
    records.append((tpos,ref,alt,[1,1,1],None,None,None))
    implicit.append(key)

print('unaligned source records',len(unaligned))
print('explicit added',explicit_added,'explicit role records skipped',explicit_skipped_ref)
print('implicit added',len(implicit))
print('total records',len(records))
assert len(seen)==len(records)

with open('/tmp/role_preflight.vcf','w') as o:
    o.write('##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n')
    o.write('##FILTER=<ID=PASS,Description="All filters passed">\n')
    o.write('##contig=<ID=chr22,length=50818468>\n')
    o.write('##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Number of chromosome copies carrying ALT (0/0, 0/1, or 1/1)">\n')
    o.write('##FORMAT=<ID=AD,Number=R,Type=Integer,Description="Allelic depths for GRCh38 REF and ALT alleles">\n')
    o.write('##FORMAT=<ID=DP,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Read depth">\n')
    o.write('##FORMAT=<ID=GQ,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Genotype quality">\n')
    o.write('#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\tF4955-78\tF4955-29\tF4955-67\n')
    for pos,ref,alt,gt,ads,dp,gq in sorted(records,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1],x[2])):
        cells=[]
        for i in range(3):
            n=gt[i]
            base='0/0' if n==0 else ('0/1' if n==1 else '1/1')
            if ads is None:
                cells.append(base)
            else:
                cells.append(f'{base}:{ads[i]}:{dp[i]}:{gq[i]}')
        fmt='GT' if ads is None else 'GT:AD:DP:GQ'
        o.write('\t'.join(['chr22',str(pos),'.',ref,alt,'.','PASS','.',fmt,*cells])+'\n')
PY
